title: WrapForge wayfinder workflow conventions
content:
Wayfinder refactor sessions on tesla-wrap-workshop follow these rules:
- All work on dev; feature/xxx branches merged back with --no-ff. Single dev→main PR at the very end; NEVER self-merge (user reviews personally).
- Every finding goes through its own spec issue ("Spec: ..." + label ready-for-agent) -> implement -> code-review before closing. Proportionate one-line security fixes may skip the spec issue if the commit documents finding/fix/test.
- pnpm always under Node 22: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm use 22.
- Local Docker unavailable: pgTAP suites + generated-types diff run only in CI and are authoritative for db changes.
- gh quirks: issue create via --body-file; issue close --reason completed --comment "$(cat file)".
- Background subagents repeatedly stalled this session when asked to EDIT files (two interrupted with zero disk changes); read-only reviewers worked. Prefer foreground subagents or inline edits for mutations.
- Roadmap lives in the session todo list: remaining = render perf (UI-05/LIB-01/02), SiteHeader (UI-03/UI-16), streaming (WU-05), DB hot-path (DB-03..08), then ~16-26 P2 polish items.
